goalZh: 会用 mine / yours / hers / ours / theirs 说东西是谁的,用 Whose…? 提问
canDoZh: 能在失物招领处辨认东西是谁的,用 mine / yours 回答,用 Whose…? 提问

newItems.noteZh: Whose cap is this? 这是谁的帽子?;whose 和 who's(= who is)读音一样,都是 /huːz/,写的时候别混。
It's mine. = It's my cap.;mine 后面不再跟名词,不说 mine cap。
Is this yours? 这是你的吗?;不加撇号,不写 your's。
It's hers. 是她的;her 放在名词前(her cap),hers 单独用。他的不管放哪儿都是 his。
It's not ours. 不是我们的;读 /aʊrz/,和 hours 同音。
These keys are theirs. 这些钥匙是他们的;th 是浊音 /ð/,不加撇号。
前面带帽檐的帽子;a 读 /æ/,嘴张大,词尾 p 收住。
美式常读成两个音节 CAM-ruh,重音在前。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Excuse me. I lost my phone here yesterday.
lines.zh: (第二天一早,圣莫尼卡码头的失物招领处)打扰一下,我昨天在这儿丢了手机。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Let me see. We have a black phone. Is this yours?
lines.zh: 我看看。这儿有一部黑色的手机。是你的吗?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: 不是,不好意思,不是我的。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: OK. Whose camera is this? Is it yours?
lines.zh: 好。这台相机是谁的?是你的吗?(问伊森)

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: And these keys? Oh, they're theirs. That family lost them.
lines.zh: 还有这串钥匙?哦,是他们的。那家人刚才来说丢了。(指着旁边一家游客)

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: And whose cap is this? Is it hers?
lines.zh: 这顶帽子是谁的?是她的吗?(看着索菲亚)

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Yes! It's mine! I didn't see it was gone.
lines.zh: 是!是我的!我都没发现它丢了。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Ha! So yours is here, but mine isn't!
lines.zh: 哈!你的在这儿,我的却不在!

questions.prompt: 工作人员拿出的那部黑色手机是磊的吗?
questions.explainZh: 工作人员问 Is this yours?,磊说 No, sorry. It's not mine.。
索菲亚说 Yes! It's mine!;钥匙才是那家游客的(they're theirs)。

questions.prompt: Is this yours? — No, it's not mine. 里的 mine 指什么?
questions.explainZh: mine 就是 my phone(我的手机),后面不用再加名词。

grammar.titleZh: mine / yours / his / hers / ours / theirs:“……的(东西)”
grammar.bodyZh: my、your、her 这些后面一定要跟名词(my phone、her cap);mine、yours、his、hers、ours、theirs 自己就代表“……的东西”,后面不再跟名词:This is my phone. = This phone is mine.。对照着记:my → mine,your → yours,his → his(不变),her → hers,our → ours,their → theirs。中国学生常见的错:说成 This is mine phone,或者写成 your's、her's——这些词都不加撇号。失物招领时最常用的一问一答:Is this yours? — Yes, it's mine! / No, it's not mine.。

examples.text: This phone is mine. = This is my phone.
Is this yours? — No, it's not mine.
examples.zh: 这是你的吗?——不,不是我的。

grammar.bodyZh: 问东西是谁的,用 Whose + 名词 + is this?:Whose cap is this?(这是谁的帽子?);东西就在眼前、大家都知道说的是哪样时,也可以只说 Whose is this?。复数用 are these:Whose keys are these?。回答用上面的 mine、hers、theirs,或者“名字 + 's”:It's Sofia's.。发音:whose 和 who's(= who is)读音一样,都是 /huːz/,只能靠意思区分:Whose cap is this?(谁的)/ Who's that?(那是谁)。

examples.text: Whose cap is this? — It's Sofia's.
examples.zh: 这是谁的帽子?——是索菲亚的。
